name: Seungmin Park
tagline: Web & mobile penetration tester. I find broken access control in open source.
about: I work on a penetration testing team in Seoul, testing web and mobile services for finance and public-sector clients.
Outside work I hunt for vulnerabilities in open-source software. I run every target in a local Docker lab and only report what I can reproduce.
Most of what I find is authorization logic: a check that exists, but looks at the wrong value.

research.intro: Every finding below was reproduced in a local lab and confirmed by the vendor.

items.summary: Cross-project IDOR exposing another tenant's message broker password in plaintext
Unauthenticated read SSRF through SEO tool actions hidden behind a login redirect
Member file uploads exposed to unauthorized users

research.pending_note: 6 more findings are confirmed by vendors and waiting for publication.
